repair: Both dedicated ephemeral CI runners temporarily set a plain core pattern while the service has zero core-file limits. The original collector policy is restored afterward; both restore steps succeeded. Application signal handlers, assertions and deadlines were unchanged after the earlier failed attempts. No local desktop settings were changed.
limits: This tests natively compiled helper source on Linux x64/ARM64, not installed Lean applications on ARM64.
The 48 installed compiled comparisons remain Linux x64 evidence from application-signal-policy-2026-09-24.json.
Deno-native observer coexistence, caller embedding, inherited state altered before JS entry, cancellation races and other native platforms remain open.
